title.zh: BitMart 停运、提现限制与重组进展
title.en: BitMart shutdown, withdrawal restrictions and restructuring

current_state.zh: 交易停运安排未变，重组和债权人分配方案等待进一步披露。
current_state.en: The trading shutdown remained; restructuring and creditor-distribution details awaited disclosure.

updates.title_zh: BitMart 在此前宣布关闭后，开始考虑部分重启和债权人偿付方案。
updates.title_en: After announcing a shutdown, BitMart began considering a partial restart and creditor payouts.
updates.what_changed_zh: BitMart 在此前宣布关闭后，开始考虑部分重启和债权人偿付方案。
updates.what_changed_en: After announcing a shutdown, BitMart began considering a partial restart and creditor payouts.
updates.current_state_zh: 重组方向已提出，但偿付条款和时间表尚未公布。
updates.current_state_en: A restructuring direction exists, but payout terms and timing were still unknown.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 据 CoinDesk 报道，BitMart 在宣布关闭数周后，正考虑部分重启并向债权人进行偿付。 这很关键，因为它可能决定 BitMart 用户能否收回资金，以及该交易所是否仍具备存续能力。在行业整合与破产频发的背景下，这也会影响用户对中心化加密货币交易所的信心。 报道称，这家交易所在宣布关闭数周后，正在权衡部分重启以及债权人偿付等选项。具体条款、金额和时间表尚未公布。
updates.detailed_summary_en: BitMart is reportedly considering a partial restart and creditor payouts weeks after it announced it would shut down, according to CoinDesk. This matters because it could determine whether BitMart's users recover funds and whether the exchange retains any viability. It also affects confidence in centralized crypto exchanges during a period of consolidation and insolvencies. The report says the exchange is weighing options for a partial restart alongside creditor payouts, weeks after the shutdown announcement. Specific terms, amounts, and timelines have not been disclosed.

updates.title_zh: 多种资产的提现被限制，且当时没有官方解释。
updates.title_en: Withdrawals for multiple assets were restricted without an official explanation at publication.
updates.what_changed_zh: 多种资产的提现被限制，且当时没有官方解释。
updates.what_changed_en: Withdrawals for multiple assets were restricted without an official explanation at publication.
updates.current_state_zh: 用户资金可用性出现新的不确定性。
updates.current_state_en: Access to user funds faced additional uncertainty.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: CryptoTicker 报道称，BitMart 已暂停多种币种的提现，引发外界对其可能遭遇安全事件或流动性短缺的猜测。截至报道发布时，BitMart 尚未发布官方声明。 主要中心化交易所暂停提现将直接影响用户动用资金的能力，并常被视为安全漏洞或偿付能力问题的早期预警信号。这一事件可能削弱用户对中心化交易所的信任，推动更多人转向自我托管。 CryptoTicker 的报道未指明哪些币种受影响，也未说明暂停是否为临时性措施。BitMart 曾有安全事件记录，包括 2021 年 12 月发生的一起重大黑客攻击，导致其大量加密资产被盗。
updates.detailed_summary_en: CryptoTicker reports that BitMart has blocked withdrawals for many coins, prompting immediate speculation about a possible security incident or liquidity shortage. No official statement had been released at the time of the report. Withdrawal freezes on a major centralized exchange directly affect users' ability to access their funds and are often viewed as an early warning sign of security breaches or solvency problems. The incident could erode trust in centralized exchanges and push more users toward self-custody. The report from CryptoTicker does not specify which coins are affected or whether the freeze is temporary. BitMart has a history of security problems, including a December 2021 breach in which a large portion of its crypto assets were stolen.

updates.title_zh: BitMart 聘请 White & Case 评估重组，并承诺最迟 9 月 9 日给出路线图。
updates.title_en: BitMart engaged White & Case to assess restructuring and said a roadmap was due by Sept. 9.
updates.what_changed_zh: BitMart 聘请 White & Case 评估重组，并承诺最迟 9 月 9 日给出路线图。
updates.what_changed_en: BitMart engaged White & Case to assess restructuring and said a roadmap was due by Sept. 9.
updates.current_state_zh: 交易停运安排未变，重组和债权人分配方案等待进一步披露。
updates.current_state_en: The trading shutdown remained; restructuring and creditor-distribution details awaited disclosure.
updates.detailed_summary_zh:
8月21日，BitMart宣布正与White & Case探讨重组方案，可能在向债权人分配的同时分阶段恢复部分服务；但先前宣布的8月26日交易关闭和提现建议时限保持不变。

此事之所以重要，是因为BitMart试图提供全面清盘之外的替代方案，但用户仍缺乏具体的偿还框架、回收率预估或时间表。这种不确定性可能削弱用户对中心化交易所的信任，并加大监管与用户对BitMart的压力。

该方案并未改变8月26日01:00 UTC现货、合约及其他交易停运的安排，也未改变建议用户在05:00 UTC前提交提现的时间。BitMart表示，逾期提交的提现请求将转入单独处理流程，并预计在9月9日前提供进一步更新。
updates.detailed_summary_en:
On Aug. 21, BitMart announced it is exploring a restructuring with White & Case that could allow phased service resumption alongside creditor distributions, while maintaining its prior Aug. 26 trading shutdown and recommended withdrawal deadline.

This matters because it attempts to offer an alternative to a full wind-down, yet customers still lack a concrete repayment framework, recovery estimate, or timetable. The uncertainty could erode trust in centralized exchanges and intensify regulatory and user pressure on BitMart.

The proposal does not change the 01:00 UTC Aug. 26 halt of spot, futures, and other trading, nor the recommended 05:00 UTC withdrawal submission time. BitMart says late withdrawal requests will move to a separate processing procedure, and the exchange expects to provide another update by Sept. 9.
